## Short answer
I could not look this up: you said Block to Context7, so no docs server is connected. From memory, not checked against the docs: in Express 5 a thrown error or rejected promise in an async route handler is passed to `next(err)` by Express itself, so `GET /orders/:id` (src/app.js:13) needs no try/catch to reach your error handling; add an error-handling middleware (`app.use((err, req, res, next) => …)`) after the routes, before `app.listen` (src/app.js:18).

## Sources used
- package.json: `"express": "^5.1.0"`; src/app.js for the route.
- No documentation: Context7 (`io.github.upstash/context7`) was proposed and blocked, and Express is not installed here (no `node_modules` to read its README from).
